get.summary: Lists the collections of a website, by name.

parameters.name: websiteId
parameters.description: The website whose collections are listed.

200.description: The website's collections with their fields and drafts.

post.summary: Creates a collection, as a draft, and the detail page its items are shown with.
post.description: Visitors don't see the collection until it is published. The detail page starts empty; design it in the studio like any page.

201.description: Created; the body is the collection.

400.description: The request is invalid, or another collection uses the slug.

404.description: No website exists with this id.

get.summary: Gets a collection with its fields and draft.

200.description: The collection.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

put.summary: Changes a collection's names and icon. These can't break anything, so they are saved directly.

200.description: Saved; the body is the collection.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

delete.summary: Deletes a collection, its items and its detail page.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

get.summary: Lists which live pages show which of the collection's fields: "Used by…" in the field editor.

200.description: One entry per page and field it shows.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

put.summary: Saves a collection's draft: its slug and fields, and where the values of removed fields go.
put.description:
Nothing changes on the site until the draft is published. Then the values of each removed field move to the field
`valueMoves` names, or are removed; pages that show a removed field must be published with it.

200.description: Saved; the body is the collection.

400.description: The request is invalid, another collection uses the slug, or a move doesn't start at a removed field.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

delete.summary: Discards a collection's draft: its slug and fields go back to the live version, and it leaves any scheduled publish.

200.description: The draft is gone; the body is the collection.

400.description: The collection was never published, so there is no live version to go back to.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

get.summary: Lists a collection's items, newest first, with their drafts.

200.description: The collection's items, newest first.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

post.summary: Adds an item to a collection, as a draft. Visitors don't see it until it is published.
post.description: Values are checked against the collection's fields (its draft's, when it has one). Required fields are checked when it is published.

201.description: Created; the body is the item.

400.description: The request is invalid; errors are keyed `slug` or `values.{fieldId}`.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

get.summary: Gets one item of a collection.

200.description: The item.

404.description: The collection has no item with this id.
The collection has no item with this id.

put.summary: Saves an item's draft: its slug and values. Nothing changes on the site until it is published.

200.description: Saved; the body is the item.

400.description: The request is invalid; errors are keyed `slug` or `values.{fieldId}`.

404.description: The collection has no item with this id.

delete.summary: Discards an item's draft: it goes back to its live version, and leaves any scheduled publish.

200.description: The draft is gone; the body is the item.

400.description: The item was never published, so there is no live version to go back to.

404.description: The collection has no item with this id.

get.summary: Lists the media items of a website, newest first.

parameters.name: websiteId
parameters.description: The website whose media library is listed.

200.description: The website's media items, newest first.

post.summary: Uploads an image to a website's media library and creates its thumbnail.
post.description:
Accepts JPEG, PNG, GIF and WebP files up to 10 MB and 100 megapixels. The file's contents are checked
as well as its extension, so a file that is not really a supported image, or is damaged, is rejected.

201.description: The image was stored; the body is the new media item.

400.description: The file is missing, empty, too large, damaged, or not a supported image.

404.description: No website exists with the given id.

get.summary: Gets a single media item's details.

200.description: The media item.

404.description: No media item exists with this id.

delete.summary: Deletes a media item together with its original image and thumbnail.

204.description: The media item and its files were deleted.

404.description: No media item exists with this id.

get.summary: Streams the original image as it was uploaded.
get.description: The response may be cached indefinitely, because a media item's files never change.

404.description: No media item or stored image exists with this id.

200.description: The original image (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP).

get.description: The response may be cached indefinitely, because a media item's files never change.

404.description: No media item or stored thumbnail exists with this id.

200.description: The WebP thumbnail.

get.summary: Gets a page's content: what visitors see, or the draft.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: `live` (the default) for what visitors see; `draft` for the draft, or the live version when there is none.

200.description: The page's content.

204.description: The page has no content in that version yet (never published, or no draft and nothing live).

404.description: No page exists with this id.

put.summary: Saves a page's draft. Nothing changes on the site until the draft is published.
put.description:
Only the document's structure is checked here (block types, ranges, safe links, allowed rich text). Content rules
such as missing images or fields that don't exist are checked when it is published (`POST /publish/check`).

200.description: Saved; the body is the draft.

404.description: No page exists with this id.

413.description: The request body is larger than 1 MB.

delete.summary: Discards a page's draft: the page goes back to its live version, and leaves any scheduled publish.

204.description: The draft is gone (or there was none).

404.description: No page exists with this id.

get.summary: Lists the pages of a website, most recently updated first.

parameters.name: websiteId
parameters.description: The website whose pages are listed.

200.description: The website's pages, most recently updated first.

get.summary: Lists every draft of a website, with what changed and when it is scheduled.

200.description: The website's drafts; empty when everything is live.

post.summary: Checks a publish against the site as it would be, without publishing anything.
post.description:
The answer lists what changes, the issues (errors block publishing), and `needs`: drafts not in the publish
that would fix a blocking issue.

200.description: The check.

404.description: A collection, page or item isn't one of the website's.

post.summary: Puts drafts live now, all at once: everything goes live, or nothing does.

200.description: Live; the body lists what went live and any warnings.

400.description: Something blocks the publish; `issues` and `needs` say what. Nothing was published.

404.description: A collection, page or item isn't one of the website's.

get.summary: Lists a website's upcoming and failed scheduled publishes, soonest first.

200.description: Pending and failed publishes.

post.summary: Schedules drafts to go live at a time. The publish is checked now, and again when it runs.
post.description: A draft can be in one scheduled publish at a time. The drafts go live as they are when it runs.

400.description: The time is in the past, a draft is already scheduled, or something blocks the publish.

404.description: A collection, page or item isn't one of the website's.

put.summary: Changes a scheduled publish's time, or what is in it. A failed publish that is changed is scheduled again.

200.description: Changed.

400.description: The time is in the past, a draft is already scheduled, or something blocks the publish.

404.description: No pending or failed publish with this id, or an id isn't one of its website's.

delete.summary: Cancels a scheduled publish. Its drafts stay drafts.

404.description: No pending or failed publish with this id.

get.summary: Lists all websites, most recently updated first.

200.description: All websites, most recently updated first.
